It is wrong: fq_tensor's multi kind always computes the coarse grid and only overlays the finer ratios, so multi=[64] is bit-identical to multi=[1,64] and this configuration IS candidate R -- the identical 8.19 % and 13.69 dB are the tell. It costs what R costs and saves nothing. Kept as the control that establishes the knob semantics.
